target.title: fix(ios): keep reconnect errors visible
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where iOS users reconnecting to a gateway would see the previous connection error replaced by “Reconnecting…” before they could read or inspect it.

## Why This Change Was Made

Keep the retained gateway problem ahead of reconnect progress in both shared status presentation and onboarding. Successful connections still win immediately, reconnect progress still appears when there is no prior error, and explicitly switching gateways clears the previous target's problem.

This is AI-assisted work. The change and its state precedence were reviewed manually and with the repository autoreview gate.

## User Impact

The most recent gateway error stays visible while iOS reconnects in the background, giving users time to read the message or open its details. No reconnect behavior or retry timing changes.

## Evidence

- Focused iOS simulator test: 77 tests across `GatewayStatusBuilderTests`, `OnboardingConnectPhaseTests`, and `GatewayConnectionControllerTests` passed before the base sync at `b7eec503cbc1c5a15383039fa632626bec5a122b`; the Swift source/test patch is unchanged at rebased head `906567b1d764ec211d9fe223726ae7ac06c87f23`.
- Same-target and changed-target regression coverage verifies that reconnecting preserves the previous error while selecting another gateway clears it.
- Exact-head Testbox changed-gate proof was attempted three times; Blacksmith shut down each lease before command execution (`tbx_01kxcn6sz9weyjfef18bkj5f9e`, `tbx_01kxcnhjv8qsn1zgvvj6j0tdsr`, `tbx_01kxcnmeqwekpc9xajfcx3nbn6`).
- Fresh branch autoreview at `37379127a3182bdf0f4778edcf354e4d2e7fe517` against `origin/main`: clean, no accepted/actionable findings; subsequent changes only rebased the unchanged Swift patch and removed the release-owned root changelog entry.
- `swiftformat --lint` passed for the touched Swift files.
- Generated iOS localization line metadata is resynced; `native-app-i18n.ts check` reports `changed=false`.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Exact-head CI run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29221158079 (in progress; macOS `ios-build` required before merge).
- Real-device/source-blind visual proof unavailable: no physical iPhone was attached.
